ticker_news.title: YieldMax® ETFs Announces Distributions on MSST, NVIT, and TEST
ticker_news.description: YieldMax announced distributions for three Performance & Distribution Target 25 ETFs (MSST, NVIT, TEST) with ex-dividend dates on February 18, 2026. The funds seek to generate income with a 25% target annual income level through call-writing strategies on MSTR, NVDA, and TSLA respectively.
ticker_news.author: Globe Newswire

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Stock Looks Undervalued as Analyst Targets Keep Moving Higher
ticker_news.description: Nvidia appears undervalued with 52 analysts rating it a Buy and a consensus price target suggesting 45% upside. Technical analysis shows a bullish pennant pattern with potential for 50-100% gains. Upcoming Q4 2025 earnings and the GTC developer conference in mid-March are expected catalysts. Institutional investors are aggressively accumulating shares, providing support for continued gains.
ticker_news.author: Thomas Hughes

ticker_news.title: Prediction: These 3 Stocks Will Be Worth More Than $500 in 5 Years
ticker_news.description: An analyst predicts that Nvidia, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Broadcom will all trade above $500 per share within five years, driven by massive AI infrastructure spending and data center capital expenditures. Taiwan Semiconductor and Broadcom need only 33% and 47% gains respectively, while Nvidia requires a 163% increase but could achieve this if it captures one-third of a $3 trillion data center market by 2030.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury
